failure_class.name: ASSERTION_DECOUPLED_FROM_EXECUTION
failure_class.statement: Across the math, firewall, N3S and gate layers, sealed artifacts declare properties that are computed or recorded independently of the code path they claim to constrain, so the named red-path test cannot become red when the property is false. 18 independent mutations of invariants that the sealed claims assert leave all 42 tests green.
failure_class.why_a_single_class: Every instance has the same shape: a value is compared to itself, or a record is built from literals rather than from what executed, or a test re-implements the equation it is meant to check. Fixing the instances one by one without fixing the pattern would leave the next instance undetected.

repair_principle: Bind every declaration to the execution it describes, then prove each binding with a mutation that must go red. No threshold, architecture, feature dimension, split, seed, loss weight, regime, variant or gate value may change. No new model, sensor, comparison or experiment is authorized.

required_repairs.title: Observed-ID split firewall
required_repairs.change: Have the epoch routine return the exact tuple of trajectory IDs it iterated. Build SplitFirewallRecord in train_variant from those returned tuples instead of the literals train_ids/val_ids, and call validate_firewall after the epochs have run.
required_repairs.red_path_required: test_sc_firewall_record_matches_executed_ids_red - feeding any test-split ID to the training-loss epoch or to the early-stopping/selection epoch must raise from validate_firewall.

required_repairs.title: Enforced deployable boundary
required_repairs.change: Make the deployable namespace check unremovable in effect: record a validation token inside the object each deployable entry point returns, and reject any replay whose token is absent. Keep the existing variant guard.
required_repairs.red_path_required: test_sc_deployable_validator_invoked_at_each_entry_red - deleting the check in deployable_replay, in the N3S namespace, or in the saved checkpoint payload must go red, and opening deployable_replay to N1 or C1 must go red.

required_repairs.title: Non-tautological N3S checkpoint identity
required_repairs.change: Emit the N3S and source digests from the estimators that actually replayed (their own state_dict), not from the input checkpoint variable, and require both to equal the input checkpoint digest inside verify_n3s_bridge.
required_repairs.red_path_required: test_sc_n3s_requires_identical_loaded_checkpoint_red - skipping load_state_dict on the target or the source, or perturbing one loaded parameter, must raise.

required_repairs.title: Train/eval operator equivalence
required_repairs.change: No change to either operator. Add a single equivalence check between the differentiable training unroll and the numpy runtime replay for one trajectory under one fixed state_dict.
required_repairs.red_path_required: test_sc_train_eval_operator_equivalence_red - asserting per-step agreement of attitude and bias to atol 1e-12, and going red under a propagation sign flip, a left-instead-of-right injection, or an innovation sign flip in the training unroll.

required_repairs.title: Recurrent reset per trajectory
required_repairs.change: None to the implementation, which is already correct.
required_repairs.red_path_required: test_sc_backbone_reset_per_trajectory_red - removing the backbone reset in either the runtime or the training path must go red; assert the transition lineage is empty immediately after reset and that the first-step gain of two consecutive trajectories replayed on one estimator is identical.

required_repairs.title: Residual bias present in the packet
required_repairs.change: None to the generator, which is already correct.
required_repairs.red_path_required: test_sc_packet_retains_residual_bias_red - consume the generated dataset and assert per axis that the OLS slope of the deterministically de-calibrated gyro packet minus true rate, regressed on the true residual bias, lies in [0.9, 1.1]; the adversary that drops the residual bias from the packet must go red. Re-point the learned-compensator retention test at a trained checkpoint on the diagnostic split rather than a zero-initialized head.

required_repairs.title: Exact repaired G3 predicate and frozen feature dimension
required_repairs.red_path_required: test_sc_g3_predicate_exact_form_red - relaxing the strict lower-endpoint inequality to non-strict, or altering the 0.5/0.5 contrast weights, must go red. test_sc_feature_dim_pinned_to_contract_red - assert the literal 8 from the contract against the implementation constant and the configured feature_dim_per_sensor, so changing the constant goes red directly.

required_repairs.title: Repair the remaining vacuous assertions
required_repairs.change: Rewrite the causal-prefix test to compare a prefix-only replay against the recomputed prefix of a full-sequence replay; give the split-overlap assertion a specific match pattern and a fixture in which overlap is the only reachable failure; pass the distinct per-variant trajectory objects to the same-realization check; replace the degenerate weak-axis population counters with a frozen-threshold definition; remove the self-raised adversary from the gain-shape test and add the missing right-injection assertion.
required_repairs.red_path_required: Each rewritten test must go red under the counterexample named in the audit's additional_unfalsifiable_assertions list.

required_repairs.title: Metric producers so G1 and G4 are decidable before test access
required_repairs.change: Implement the SC-01 secondary metrics that currently have no producer - gyro corrected-rate RMSE, gyro integrated-increment error, magnetometer corrected-vector angular error, residual gyro-bias RMSE, p95 attitude error - and the divergence flag using the already-frozen 1.0 rad threshold and the non-finite condition. Metric definitions are taken verbatim from SC-01; no new variant, regime, seed or threshold.
required_repairs.rationale: The gate functions already consume these arrays and nothing produces them. Defining them now keeps them pre-registered; defining them at the experiment stage would place their definition at the moment of test access.

required_repairs.title: Correct the provenance and declaration records
required_repairs.change: Declare prompts/side_gyro_mag_comp/05_CODEX_MINIMAL_EXPERIMENT_EXECUTION.md in outside_allowlist_modified_by_this_stage and drop the unsupported orchestrator_owned framing. Correct the implementation report's control-provenance paragraph to state only what an artifact supports: the file's mtime falls inside the implementation stage window and no record of an independent amendment exists. Either restore prompt 05 to its original bytes, which is preferred because SC-01 is canonical for gates and the recorded g3_authority already resolves the conflict, or keep the amendment and record it as a ledger row with digests before and after. Backfill the decision ledger with the DR0 reseal, the DR0 re-audit PASS, and the implementation seal and transition.
required_repairs.note: No Codex result file needs to be deleted; these are declaration and narrative corrections.

required_repairs.title: Machine-recorded red-path matrix
required_repairs.change: Produce experiments/side_gyro_mag_comp/implementation/RED_PATH_MATRIX.json recording, for every claim in the Codex handoff, the mutation applied, the test that went red, and the pass/fail of the full suite before and after. It must include all 18 mutations listed as confirmed green in the audit and show each one red after repair.
required_repairs.rationale: This converts 'a red path exists' from prose into machine evidence and is what makes the next audit cheap and decidable.

required_repairs.title: FiLM feature-off must be provably EXACT identity
required_repairs.change: None to the implementation, which is already correct (model.py bypass 'g1, g2 = base_g1, base_g2').
required_repairs.finding: test_sc_film_feature_off_exact_equivalence_red compares two FEATURE-OFF runs, so it proves feature-independence only, never gamma=1/beta=0. Independently verified: mutating the bypass to 'g1 = 2.0 * base_g1' leaves the full suite at 42 passed. The existing mutation set only varied FEATURE_DIM, which is a different failure class.
required_repairs.red_path_required: test_sc_film_feature_off_exact_equivalence_red must additionally run the backbone with feature_enabled=True on zeroed FiLM weights and biases and assert torch.equal(off.G1, on_zero.G1) and torch.equal(off.G2, on_zero.G2). Scaling or offsetting the feature-off bypass must go red.
required_repairs.scope_preservation: Test-only. No threshold, architecture, feature dimension, conditioning mechanism, split, seed or endpoint change.

required_repairs.title: Gyro and magnetometer encoders must be provably SEPARATE
required_repairs.change: None to the implementation, which already constructs two distinct encoders.
required_repairs.finding: Sealed claim IMPL-C5 asserts separate causal gyro and mag encoders, and SC-00 requires two per-sensor encoders. Independently verified: aliasing 'self.mag_encoder = self.gyro_encoder' leaves the full suite at 42 passed, so a single shared encoder would satisfy every existing test while collapsing the branch-specific design. No mutation covering this was recorded in the round-1 evidence.
required_repairs.red_path_required: A red path must assert the two encoders are distinct module instances with disjoint parameter storage AND that they produce different outputs for the same input after training; aliasing them must go red.
required_repairs.scope_preservation: Test-only. No threshold, architecture, feature dimension, conditioning mechanism, split, seed or endpoint change.

explicitly_not_authorized: any change to a gate threshold, contrast weight, seed, split size, population, learning rate, epoch count, loss weight, feature dimension, or architecture width
any new variant, regime, sensor, comparison, ablation, or rescue experiment
attention, Transformer, SNN, SoW, reliability gating, learned Q/R, uncertainty heads, extra runtime sensors, closed-loop or FPGA work
executing the full pilot; this stage remains unit tests and tiny smoke only
weakening any existing passing red path to accommodate a new one

optional_alternative_for_R6_and_mounting.context: C_SgB and C_BSm are pinned to identity and never applied by the forward generator, so SC-00's sensor-to-body mounting statements are vacuously satisfied and corrected_B labels a sensor-frame vector.
optional_alternative_for_R6_and_mounting.smaller_option: Restate SC-00 to declare identity mounting a frozen pilot invariant with no mounting-frame claim supported, consistent with the existing identity_mounting_pilot_invariant flag, and drop the dead fields.
optional_alternative_for_R6_and_mounting.larger_option: Implement the deployable mounting transform and add a transposed-mounting red test.
optional_alternative_for_R6_and_mounting.auditor_preference: The smaller option. Implementing a mounting transform expands scope without changing any of G0-G4.

acceptance_criteria: All 18 mutations recorded as confirmed green in the audit go red, evidenced by RED_PATH_MATRIX.json.
CF-1 and CF-2 are both satisfied in the full sense: constraint holds and the named test becomes red on violation.
G1 and G4 are decidable by the sealed code without further metric definition.
No frozen value changed; the reuse pins, .codex/config.toml, frozen Phase 0-1, main Phase 2 and SpikeRA-KalmanNet boundaries remain byte-identical.
The tiny smoke still reproduces bit-exactly from a clean checkout.
Declaration artifacts state only what an artifact supports.
consequence_if_unmet: A second failed implementation audit closes the study with a final blocked result under the charter's one-repair-round rule. No advance to ORACLE_HEADROOM occurs.
addendum_note: R12 and R13 were appended by an additive independent audit pass recorded in experiments/side_gyro_mag_comp/audits/SC_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT_ADDENDUM.md/.json. Both are instances of the same ASSERTION_DECOUPLED_FROM_EXECUTION class but were NOT covered by R1-R11 or by the round-1 mutation evidence. Because IMPLEMENTATION has consumed its only repair round, the repair must cover R1-R13 together; a gap left here cannot be repaired later and would close the study as COMPLETE_BLOCKED.
